```yaml
name: Test bpftrace

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test-bpftrace:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          profile: minimal

      - name: Build helloworld
        run: cargo build --manifest-path rust/helloworld/Cargo.toml
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify hello symbol in helloworld
        run: |
          set -e
          binary=rust/helloworld/target/debug/helloworld
          if ! nm "$binary" | grep -q '_ZN10helloworld5hello'; then
            echo "Symbol _ZN10helloworld5hello not found in $binary"
            exit 1
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Build args
        run: cargo build --manifest-path rust/args/Cargo.toml
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify hello symbol in args
        run: |
          set -e
          binary=rust/args/target/debug/args
          if ! nm "$binary" | grep -q '_ZN10helloworld5hello'; then
            echo "Symbol _ZN10helloworld5hello not found in $binary"
            exit 1
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Run args binary
        run: |
          set -e
          ./rust/args/target/debug/args
          echo "args binary executed successfully"
        shell: bash

      - name: Install bpftrace
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace
        shell: bash

      - name: Test bpftrace attach to args binary
        run: |
          set -e
          binary=rust/args/target/debug/args
          # Start the binary in background
          "$binary" &
          pid=$!
          # Give the binary a moment to start
          sleep 1
          # Run bpftrace to attach to the hello function
          output=$(sudo bpftrace -e "uprobe:$(realpath $binary):_ZN10helloworld5hello* { printf(\"hello called\\n\"); }" -p $pid)
          # Wait for the binary to finish
          wait $pid
          echo "$output"
          if ! echo "$output" | grep -q "hello called"; then
            echo "bpftrace did not capture hello function call"
            exit 1
          fi
        shell: bash
```
